question: Who among the following Indian musicians is the inventor of Mohan Veena?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt** is the inventor of the Mohan Veena.
 
• The Mohan Veena is a modified version of the slide guitar, adapted to Indian classical music.
 
• Pandit Vishwa Mohan Bhatt has received numerous accolades for his contribution to music, including the prestigious Grammy Awa
